kind: source-derived traversal model, not measured visit counters

symbols.T: membership-word reads in one complete next_trim_span traversal
symbols.M: word fragments touched by set_trim_span across selected runs

bounds.T: at most 2 * R + 2 * W; a fragmented word can be read again for each run
bounds.M: at most R + W; source-level upper bound, not emitted-instruction count

same_in_both: Owner idle census examines N payload indices for each eligible Group visit and builds current live coverage.
Enrollment examines at most N payload indices per eligible Group; polling/scheduling determines total visits.
Admission validates P selected page states/live bits before writing P states to trimming.
Confirmed completion validates P page states before writing P states absent.
Full-batch run count and Group jobs remain equal in the wrapped histories; no repeated batch16 census.

baseline.admission: Two R-span passes around P validation reads and P state writes. Enrollment coalesces pages into the pre-reserved vector.
baseline.helper: R span reads and R discard-result bit assignments; one madvise and then one mprotect per successful discard attempt.
baseline.reply: R span reads and R discard-result bit reads; failed spans compacted in place; successful spans call finish_trim.

bitmap.admission: Two membership traversals (2*T) around the same P validation reads and P state writes. Enrollment sets P page-membership bits; success clearing writes W words. has_trim adds at most W word reads per call.
bitmap.helper: One membership traversal (T), R run emissions, and at most M success-word updates after successful whole-run syscalls. It does not read mutable Page state.
bitmap.reply: One membership traversal (T), R success-bit reads, and at most M membership-word clears for successful runs; the same finish_trim page checks/writes.
bitmap.retry: Retained membership avoids new candidate-page enrollment/admission; has_trim reads at most W words and clears W success words before the same full run traversal.

interpretation: One forward cursor emits each maximal run once and preserves cross-word coalescing. It does not guarantee that each bitmap word is loaded only once. No actual visit count or speed claim is inferred.
qualification_scope: Final dead-TrimSpan API cleanup; full-batch bitmap admission/helper/reply processing remains represented by these source-derived bounds. No measured visit counters.
